rationale: The inline success shape is extracted as EnvironmentRoleUpdateResponse so the response has a stable named schema without changing its fields.

slug.description: A unique slug for the role.

name.description: A descriptive name for the role.

description.description: An optional description of the role.
description.example: Full administrative access to all resources

type.description: Whether the role is scoped to the environment or an organization (custom role).

resource_type_slug.description: The slug of the resource type the role is scoped to.

permissions.description: The permission slugs assigned to the role.

provenance.observed: The operation declares its EnvironmentRoleUpdateResponse success shape inline at /paths/~1authorization~1roles~1{slug}/patch/responses/200/content/application~1json/schema.
provenance.specd: The SDK exposes the same success shape through the named EnvironmentRoleUpdateResponse component.
